summary: Almaden Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the submission of its Reply in ongoing international arbitration proceedings against Mexico under the CPTPP, seeking damages of US$2.68 billion for loss of its Ixtaca project. No special-situation corporate event (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, restructuring) is disclosed. The filing is a routine update on litigation funding and procedural steps, including a scheduled hearing in December 2026. As a foreign private issuer report, this does not map to a US special-situation category.
